title: Origin of Divine Protection of Sword Saint
text: The "Divine Protection of Sword Saint" came about because Reid was just too ridiculously strong, so it was something Od Lagna created as a result, and it started being granted from the next generation's "Sword Saint" onward—which means the original him was pure raw talent, no blessings. He's basically the embodiment of violence in the Re:Zero world, someone who's about equally terrifying whether he's wielding a sword or not.
